readme: Reviewed, legitimate reasons a store that appears to carry a commodity is NOT on the board. audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 skips these so it only alerts on NEW/unreviewed gaps. Remove an entry to force a re-review (e.g. once we can price it).

allow.reason: Only appears in a combined 'blueberries, raspberries, strawberries or berry medley' ad line - no clean per-berry price/size to compare. Revisit if Hy-Vee everyday pull captures a standalone blueberry pack.
Sold by the '1 pint container' (a volume, not a weight) at $4.99; no comparable per-ounce weight without guessing. Revisit if the product page exposes a net weight.
